memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Irritable bowel syndrome and subclinical hypothyroidism.
Patient reports intermittent abdominal bloating, alternating constipation and diarrhoea for 6 months, mild fatigue, weight stable. Abdomen soft, mild tenderness in left lower quadrant, no masses. Vital signs normal. Smoking status: never. No inhaler prescribed. Technique not applicable.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Levothyroxine 50 mcg oral daily
Mebeverine 135 mg oral twice daily
Ispaghula husk 5 g oral once daily
Loperamide 2 mg oral as needed for diarrhea

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH 4.2 mIU/L (0.4-4.0) – slightly high
Free T4 11.2 pmol/L (10-22) – normal
Hb 13.4 g/dL (12-16)
WBC 6.8 x10^9/L (4-10)
Platelets 210 x10^9/L (150-400)
Stool routine: ova and cysts negative, no occult blood
tTG-IgA < 2 U/mL (<7) – negative

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been taking the medicines as prescribed. Bloating is better but I still get loose stools after spicy food. Energy levels are okay, no new symptoms.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Irritable bowel syndrome stable; hypothyroidism improving.
Patient reports reduced bloating, occasional diarrhoea after meals, less fatigue. Exam: abdomen non-tender, no organomegaly. Smoking status: never. No inhaler prescribed. Technique not applicable.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-10-05 at 10:30 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Irritable bowel syndrome persistent; euthyroid on levothyroxine 75 mcg.
Patient reports ongoing post‑prandial diarrhoea, occasional constipation, mild abdominal discomfort. Exam: benign. Smoking status: never. No inhaler prescribed. Technique not applicable.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Dr K. Rao, Gastroenterology, Vikram Hospital for evaluation of refractory IBS symptoms, including possible dietary triggers and need for colonoscopy.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Gastroenterologist reviewed: symptoms consistent with IBS‑D. Recommended low‑FODMAP trial, rifaximin 550 mg TID for 14 days if bloating persists. Colonoscopy normal. Advised continue current symptomatic meds.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Irritable bowel syndrome partially controlled; euthyroid.
Patient tried low‑FODMAP for 4 weeks with modest improvement; reports occasional urgency. Abdomen soft, no tenderness. Smoking status: never. No inhaler prescribed. Technique not applicable.
